section.p: Consider a document where a Heading 1 groups related Heading 2 sections but contains no direct body content of its own. All paragraphs, tables, and images appear under Heading 2 or deeper headings.

row.entry: [Heading 1]: Installation (No body content under Heading 1) [Heading 2]: Prerequisites [Heading 3]: System Requirements [Heading 2]: Installing the Server (No body content under Heading 1)

section.p: Result:No .dita topic file is created for Heading 1: Installation because it has no body content. The converter maps it to a <topichead> element and nests the related Heading 2 and Heading 3 topics under it. No .dita topic file is created for Heading 2: Installing the Servereither because it has no body content. The converter maps it to a <topichead> element.
